title: eulophia cristata
intro: Eulophia cristata, commonly known as the "Horned Orchid", is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia cristata are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
